items.title: The Euler characteristic of a coherent module twisted by a locally free module on a proper curve is linear in the degree and the rank
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves chi(X, E tensor F) = r deg(E) + n chi(X, F) for a locally free E of rank n and a coherent F of rank r on a proper curve. The proof applies the general criterion for a property of coherent sheaves to hold on all of them: it verifies that the property P(F) expressed by the formula is additive in short exact sequences, because both the Euler characteristic and the rank are additive, and that it holds for the two test sheaves required by the criterion, namely O_X (where it is the definition of the degree) and i_*O_Z for a closed point (where r = 0 and the claim reduces to the finite support lemma) (proof lines 9681-9692). H2: setting up the property and verifying the two test cases of the criterion is the substance.
